rows.findingAndDisposition: Each label is tied to a visible original mark: continuous curve, broken line, short strokes. The transfer asks for the pupil’s own tool action; it does not grade resemblance.
The key separates tone from paper size and reach. Adding a pencil layer is qualified and pupils check their actual marks.
The geometric prediction specifies the same tent and equal panel lengths. Real paper is checked after the model reason, and lean/support is tested rather than promised fixed.
A join that remains attached is distinct from a whole form tipping. Tape must bridge the actual surfaces. Failed trials are retained as learning.
Questions are judged against an explicit purpose, avoiding ambiguous artist/organisation bins. Real artist and group exploration remain required and unconfirmed slots stay open.
Readiness, joining, responding and retaining a true record form a real sequence. Unready sessions remain labelled practice. The record cannot fabricate an artist’s reply.
The original room diagram is expressly made-up. Display, tools and discussion locations are visible; no actual venue, booking, staffing or access provision is asserted.

A logo and an old film do not attest active exploration. Real record cases require the action and source. The revised model distinguishes a supported shared event from a personal comparison or an employment claim.
Wet-tool drag is a qualified prediction. A paper comparison keeps tool/paint similar and requires observed results, including surprises; making remains part of the lesson.
The order keeps a loose layout before glue changes it. Pressing and dry-edge checking follow the join, with assistance and consent preserved.
Painting over a mark cannot preserve the before state. A separate real trial or record is kept. Newness is not treated as proof of a better artistic choice.
Test strips and the whole final artwork show different evidence. An unfinished maker-selected task remains unfinished; pupils keep both process and final work.
The given messages distinguish stated enjoyment from a stated achievement. A bare description needs the maker’s account; an adult does not invent it.
The keyed labels refer only to visible artwork details. The exact example message is preserved and no emotion or ease is added. Each pupil shares their own real view.
